channel.title: Applied Linguistics — Calls for Papers & Conferences
channel.description: Aggregated, filtered feed of calls for papers and conference announcements relevant to applied linguistics, crawled and pulled from LINGUIST List, Ling Alert, WikiCFP and other sources.

item.title: [LINGUIST List — Conference Announcements] Confs: ICAME48 Pre-conference Workshop: Towards "Big and Tidy" in English Corpus Linguistics
item.description: The increasing availability of very large corpora, advances in corpus annotation, and recent developments in AI-assisted data enrichment are creating new opportunities to rethink one of the longstanding assumptions of corpus linguistics: that corpora are either "small and tidy" or "big and messy". item.description: The Department of Linguistics of the School of Philology, Aristotle University of Thessaloniki, Greece is organizing its 47th Annual Meeting on 14 May 2027, on the theme: Synchronic and Diachronic Approaches to the Semantics and Pragmatics of Greek and its Dialects The conference focuses on the synchronic study of linguistic meaning and use, and on the interface between semantics/pragmatics and the history of Greek, as well as geographical and social dialectology. item.title: [LINGUIST List — Conference Announcements] Confs: Argument Structure, Passives and Non-Agentive Subjects across Modalities
item.description: Scope and Objectives: The workshop explores passives, argument structure, transitivity, and non-agentive subjects, from a crosslinguistic and crossmodal perspective, aiming to identify the general grammatical principles and modality-specific mechanisms underlying these phenomena. It brings together research on spoken and sign languages and welcomes descriptive, typological, formal, functionalist and experimental approaches, focusing on morphology, syntax, semantics and/or pragmatics. item.description: We are pleased to share the Call for papers for the upcoming international conference titled "Language Contact in Literature: Findings, Problems and New Directions", which will take place from May 28 to 29, 2027, at the Slovak Academy of Sciences, in Bratislava. The event aims to spark a new dialogue across translation theory, literary multilingualism, world and postcolonial literature, and contact linguistics. item.description: Languages are much more than tools for communication: they carry identities, histories, values, and ways of understanding the world. Recognising and valuing linguistic diversity from the earliest years of life can help nurture openness towards others, challenge prejudice, and foster empathy, respect, and a sense of belonging. item.title: [LINGUIST List — Calls for Papers] Calls: The Journal on Ethnopolitics and Minority Issues in Europe - "Special Issue: Kurdish and European Minority Language Translation in Dialogue" (Jrnl)
item.description: Translation into and out of minority languages in Europe and the Middle East operates under conditions of asymmetric institutional recognition, fragmented standardization, and uneven access to publication and broadcast infrastructures. For Kurdish communities across Iran, Iraq, Turkey, and Syria, as well as in European diasporas, translation constitutes a site where language policy, state power, and minority identity converge. item.title: [LINGUIST List — Calls for Papers] Calls: Journal of Experimental Pragmatics
item.description: We are delighted to announce that the Journal of Experimental Pragmatics is now live! A new community owned, Diamond Open Access journal dedicated to research on meaning, inference, communication, and language use in context. Built by and for the research community, JXPrag combines transparent peer review, a novel Voluntary Action Editor model, and free publishing for authors.
